Protect your myIDTravel Privileges
with Expert Auditing

MIG helps airlines protect their myIDTravel privileges through expert compliance audits, ensuring only eligible staff and beneficiaries benefit from staff travel — protecting your company’s most valued employee perk.

Get Started

We help airlines audit and optimize their myIDTravel systems to ensure full compliance.

myIDTravel is a privileged program strictly for verified airline and industry staff. Compliance with myIDTravel’s eligibility rules is critical.

myIDTravel abuse puts your entire staff travel program at risk. We audit, monitor, and protect your MyIDTravel access so you can operate with confidence and compliance.

Our experts have helped global carriers reduce fraud risk by up to 70%, ensuring only eligible employees and verified family members are using internal travel benefits.

Ensuring myIDTravel compliance is not just a regulatory requirement, it’s essential for protecting your business, safeguarding travelers, and keeping operations smooth and secure.

  • Protect your company’s revenue and industry reputation.
  • Avoid losing myIDTravel privileges due to policy or compliance breaches.
  • Improve employee knowledge and communication and reduce misuse.

Why does myIDTravel
compliance matter?

myIDTravel is a privileged benefit program that is strictly for verified airline employees and industry staff.

Compliance with myIDTravel’s eligibility rules is critical.

Yet throughout the entire industry, users have been abusing the program, adding unauthorized members as beneficiaries.

Non-compliance doesn’t just create paperwork headaches; it can put contracts, safety records, and reputation at risk.

Our 100% virtual approach means we can step in quickly, assess thoroughly, and help you stay audit-ready anywhere in the world.
